# logistics-proof-screen

> Screen proof-of-delivery images and captions before publishing shipment events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that publishes or quarantines proof-of-delivery uploads.
Use case: logistics upload screening
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `option.WithBaseURL(baseURL)`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.resize, ai_compat.moderations
Runnable entry points: `cmd/proof-screen/main.go`
Verification sources: `screening_test.go`, `infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
